test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: By what percentage is one-third of 90 lesser that three-eights of 160?
solution:
**Formula used:**

% Change = (New - Initial)/Initial × 100

**Calculation:**

1/3rd of 90 = 90 × (1/3)

⇒ 30

3/8th of 160 = 160 × (3/8)

⇒ 60

Difference = New - Initial

⇒ 60 - 30 = 30

Required % = (30/60) × 100

⇒ 50%

**∴ The required answer is 50%.**
